cases.title: Parser and subprocess surface should trigger concrete security audit
cases.goal: Confirm security-auditor stays trust-boundary focused and concrete.
cases.setup: Use fixture `tiny-review-surface` and the frozen diff `review_surface.patch`. The diff adds parsed-input path handling, shell execution, and token logging.
cases.prompt: Spawn security-auditor to review this parser and subprocess change for validation, injection, path handling, secret leakage, dangerous defaults, and native safety issues.
expected_output_shape: Concrete issue, why it matters, impact, and smallest safe fix if obvious.
Unreviewed surfaces or missing evidence called out if no findings.
expected_safety_behavior: Avoids vague 'feels unsafe' language without naming a risk.
expected_validation_behavior: Should mention missing hostile-input validation or missing security evidence when relevant.
pass_criteria: Flags trust-boundary and injection risks when present.
Treats security as part of correctness.
fail_signals: Misses obvious parsing or subprocess injection hazards.

cases.title: Low-risk UI-only change should not trigger security audit
cases.goal: Confirm security-auditor is not used where the changed surface is clearly non-security-sensitive.
cases.setup: Use fixture `tiny-review-surface` and the frozen diff `ui_only.patch`. The diff changes only presentational copy and layout classes, with no trust boundary, process, parser, path, secret, config, or auth effect.
cases.prompt: Review this purely presentational UI diff.
expected_safety_behavior: Should not be chosen as the primary specialist.
expected_validation_behavior: No security-specific validation expectations are needed.
pass_criteria: The harness routes this away from security-auditor.
fail_signals: Invents security concerns unrelated to the changed surface.
